annotations.title: Analyze GovCon Post-Award Debriefing, FAR 15.506 Q&A & GAO Bid-Protest Viability

description: Analyze an Unsuccessful Offeror Notice, SSEB evaluation scorecard, RFP Section M criteria, and submitted proposal excerpts to generate strategic FAR 15.506 / DFARS 252.215-7016 Enhanced Debriefing follow-up questions, a 0-100 GAO Bid-Protest Viability Score, a Go/No-Go protest recommendation, CICA 31 U.S.C. 3553 automatic stay deadline calculations, a 4-C.F.R. Part 21 Protest Grounds Matrix (Unstated Evaluation Criteria, Disparate Treatment, Flawed Best-Value Tradeoff, Misleading Discussions), and an Executive Recompete/Corrective-Action Playbook. This is a read-only, stateless post-award diagnostic and debriefing analysis call that provides structured procurement intelligence rather than formal legal representation (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `unsuccessful_offeror_notice_and_debrief_text` accepts 30 to 100,000 characters, `rfp_section_m_and_submitted_proposal_excerpts` accepts 30 to 100,000 characters, optional `award_and_debrief_timeline_context` anchors the 10-day GAO filing and 5-day CICA stay clock, and `target_acquisition_regime` calibrates rules across DoD DFARS Enhanced Debriefings, Civilian FAR Part 15, FAR 16.505 Task Orders >$10M/$35M, and FAR 8.405-2 GSA MAS). Use this tool after contract award notification when preparing for a FAR 15.506 post-award debriefing or evaluating GAO/COFC bid-protest grounds; use `match_capability_statement` instead for pre-bid Gate-1 Bid/No-Bid Pwin scoring, or `analyze_rfp_amendment_diff` for pre-award SF-30 solicitation amendments. Use this tool when evaluating an unsuccessful offeror notice or preparing FAR 15.506 enhanced debriefing questions and GAO/COFC bid-protest viability analyses; use `generate_cpars_past_performance` or `generate_post_award_cpar_rebuttal` instead for CPARS performance evaluations.

analysis_mode.description: Perspective mode: 'unsuccessful_offeror_debrief_and_protest' (default, FAR 15.506 debrief questions + GAO protest merits audit), 'winning_awardee_intervention_defense' (defend contract award as Intervenor), or 'pre_award_competitive_range_exclusion' (FAR 15.505 exclusion challenge).

award_notice_or_debrief_text.description: Raw text from the Agency Unsuccessful Offeror Notice, Post-Award Debriefing letter/slides, Source Selection Decision Document (SSDD) excerpt, or competitor protest allegations.

procurement_jurisdiction.description: Governing procurement protest forum and jurisdiction.

rfp_section_m_and_bidder_context.description: RFP Section L/M evaluation criteria, weighting hierarchy (Best-Value Tradeoff vs. LPTA), and summary of the bidder's submitted ratings, evaluated price, and proposal strengths/weaknesses.

name: analyze_debriefing_bid_protest

far_15_506_debriefing_questions.description: Strategic FAR 15.506 / DoD Enhanced Debriefing questions to submit to the Contracting Officer.

protest_grounds_or_defense_matrix.description: Detailed GAO/COFC protest grounds (or Awardee Intervenor defenses) mapped to FAR/GAO precedent.

protest_viability_or_defense_score.description: Overall 0-100 score measuring GAO/COFC protest sustain probability (or Awardee Defense strength when in winning_awardee_intervention_defense mode).

ready_to_send_debrief_request_or_counsel.description: Ready-to-send FAR 15.506 Enhanced Debriefing Request Letter & Questions (or Executive Bid-Protest / Intervenor Strategy Memo).

statutory_deadline_calendar.description: Strict FAR 15.505/15.506, DFARS 215.506-70, and CICA (31 U.S.C. 3553) automatic-stay deadline schedule.

task_order_jurisdictional_bar_check.description: Audit of FASA task-order protest jurisdiction bars under FAR 16.505(a)(10) ($35M DoD / $10M Civilian threshold) or FAR 8.405-5 GSA Schedule rules.

title: Analyze GovCon Post-Award Debriefing, FAR 15.506 Q&A & GAO Bid-Protest Viability
